description: The file defines a Java class 'ReportingData' that serves as a data container aggregating lists of domain model objects such as clients, projects, employees, users, and application info. It includes getter and setter methods, and overrides equals, hashCode, and toString methods using Apache Commons Lang builder utilities.

classes.name: ReportingData
